title: Update experience years from 10+ to 7+

requirements.text: In the AboutSection component, update the text '10+ years experience' to '7+ years experience'.

quotes: Can we change the 10+ years experience to 7+ years instead

acceptanceCriteria: The AboutSection no longer displays '10+ years experience' anywhere on the page.
The AboutSection displays '7+ years experience' in the same location and style as before.

nonGoals: Changing any other text, layout, or styling on the page.
